subject: GetYourGuide day tours from London that include the Cotswolds, grouped by what the day covers
source: data/day-trips/gyg-inventory.json (destinations.Cotswolds, 47 product ids) plus product pages opened one at a time in the browser pane at https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t<id>
method: 13 product pages rendered and read on 12 September 2026. Price and rating come from each page's own application/ld+json Product block; inclusions and exclusions from the DOM rows by their tick/cross icon, not from the title; village stop lengths from the page's own itinerary timeline; group size from the 'Know before you go' block; departure point from the meeting-point block. Five more products (876613, 602620, 593863, 1408818, 1408799) were verified by the sibling passes recorded in stonehenge-tours.json and bath-tours.json and are reused here rather than re-read.
headline: The Cotswolds is the cleanest destination on the platform to recommend: every village on every itinerary is free to walk round, so a transport-and-guide-only inclusion list costs the reader nothing. The real differences are village line-up, minutes on the ground versus minutes in the coach, group size and departure point. The conditional-entry trap only reappears where Blenheim Palace or the Roman Baths are bolted on.

groups.verdict: 215430 is the pick on every axis that matters: most reviews of any Cotswolds product by a factor of five, a 16-passenger cap, and four villages with real free time rather than a seven-stop dash.
795342 at GBP 74 is the cheapest credible one and its three stops total 4h 20m on the ground. 1124804 at GBP 75 gives the same three villages with a longer Burford and Bibury but has only 46 reviews.

593863 is the only Bath-plus-Cotswolds product read whose inclusions carry Roman Baths entry with no conditional clause. 1408818 and 1408799 print it as 'only if purchased' despite the title, and have no reviews.

876613 is Stonehenge plus the Cotswolds with no Bath, and it is the only one in this family with the Stonehenge ticket inside the price. 602620 is the better-rated small group but excludes the Stonehenge ticket, plainly and with the price table printed, so budget GBP 24.65-29.32 on top.

60796 is the most-booked Cotswolds product on the platform, but its own 'Know before you go' says up to 53 passengers and the Cotswolds share of the day is 30 minutes in Burford plus an hour in Bourton. 595854 is the small-group alternative at GBP 89.01 and adds an hour in Stratford.

The one Cotswolds product where the entry trap applies. Blenheim Palace entry reads 'if option selected' in the inclusions; the GBP 79 flexi option is a coach seat and a walk round the 754-hectare grounds, not the state rooms. Door price is GBP 31.

123059 is the only Cotswolds product read whose inclusions carry three attraction entries with no conditional wording: Highclere Castle, Cogges Manor Farm and Bampton Library. At GBP 229 it is priced accordingly.
